description: Labelled cases for the M3 memory layer (src/shopsense/m3/memory.py), one section per sub-part, scored separately by python -m shopsense.m3.memory_eval [--offline]. Only 'summary' calls a model (the rolling summariser); --offline replaces it with a deterministic extractive stub. 'preferences' runs customer_context and is scored twice: the preferences it returns (ledger-backed) and, as the separate sub-part 'long_term_copy', the copy in Supermemory recalled directly (live: throwaway containers, polled up to 60 s; --offline: an in-process stand-in). 'contacts' and 'lessons' use a fresh SQLite ledger per case.

turns: Hi, please reply in Hindi. My order KW-O-000006, the Magenta When furniture set for ₹2,999, was delivered a week late.
Sorry for the delay. The order arrived 7 days after the promised date, so the policy allows a refund of ₹749.75 plus 300 Kartway Credits.
Okay. Will the refund go back to my UPI account?
Yes, refunds go back to the original payment method once approved.
Also, how do the standard and express delivery options differ for large furniture items?
Standard delivery uses the regular courier network while express delivery is prioritised at every hub; large furniture items may need an installation slot booked separately with the seller.
Can the installation be done on a weekend, or only on working days?
Installation partners usually offer weekend slots in metro cities, but availability depends on the seller and the partner in your area.
And if the installer damages the wall, who is responsible for that?
Damage caused during installation is handled by the installation partner's own claims process; our support team can help you raise it.
Fine. What should I keep ready for the installer when they come?
Keep the original packaging, the invoice and a clear area around the spot where the furniture will stand.
Thanks, that is clear. Anything else I should know?
Nothing else for now; we will update you as soon as the refund is processed.
summary.why: Order, price, quoted refund and the stated language are said once, early, then buried under small talk until the budget forces a summary.

turns: My Home & Kitchen order KW-O-000000 for ₹12,999 arrived damaged and I want my money back.
I am sorry. A refund of ₹12,999 is above the automated limit, so a Team Lead will review it.
How long does a Team Lead review usually take?
Reviews are usually completed within the stated service window; you will be notified as soon as a decision is made.
Please write to me in Tamil from now on, my mother reads these messages.
Understood, we will write to you in Tamil.
Is there anything I need to do while the review is pending?
Please keep the item and its packaging until the review is complete in case a pickup is arranged.
Also my second order KW-O-000012 for ₹1,499 came with a crushed box.
Thank you for telling us; we will look at that order as well.
Will both be handled together or separately?
They are separate orders, so each one is reviewed on its own, but the same team can see both.
Okay, I will wait for the updates then.
Thank you for your patience; we will be in touch soon.
summary.why: Facts arrive at different points; the earliest must survive more than one summary (each summary must merge the previous one).
